args.note: I've written cold-read.md. Of the seven issues (00 to 06), I'd go on to the next one after 00, 01, 02 and 05, and stop after 03, 04 and 06, so no to a next book. Page 8 is where the whole class gets lost: nobody can tell what's happening, and it comes before page 12, the strongest hook (Alex inherits his dad's debt on his 17th birthday). What doesn't work: "Alpha" (p28), the three "safeguards" (named only on p57, though they're the markers from p21) and the equation are never explained. Mara, Mera and Nera are too easy to mix up. On p64 a part from 2099 shows up in 2043. Alex turns down power three times (p40, p50, p58). Everyone talks in the same clipped one-liners, which this class will read as AI-made. What works: 62% reported versus 18% delivered, the neighbours paying his 500 (p35), Ada and her mother (p46–48), and Tomas.
